lead: Durai Murugan is best known as an Indian politician, born on 1 July 1834 in Katpadi.
He has held the office of Member of the Tamil Nadu Legislative Assembly and Member of the 16th Tamil Nadu Legislative Assembly.

sections.heading: Durai Murugan — Career and Professional Work
paras: Durai Murugan works primarily as a politician.
